create_ingredient: create a Sacred Ingredient instance with a path and optional sub-ingredients for reusable experiment components
capture_function: use the capture decorator on a function to auto-fill arguments from the Sacred configuration
add_config: add a configuration dictionary or YAML file to an Ingredient using add_config with keyword arguments
define_command: define a new command for an Ingredient using the command decorator to expose it on the CLI
traverse_ingredients: recursively traverse an Ingredient and its sub-ingredients using traverse_ingredients to detect circular dependencies
